newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks cautious after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks cautious after U.S. data.

text.p: French stocks moved up then slid back after the U.S. government revised its first-quarter GDP growth figure to 5.8 percent -- above the 5.6 percent initially reported, but slightly below market expectations.
Traders said the French market will remain nervous about Sunday's parliamentary election runoff until the close.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 32.36 points, or 1.25 percent at 2,546.88 at 1258 GMT -- off its session low of 2,536.08. The May CAC-40 futures contract was down 32 at 2,543.
Volume was a brisk seven billion francs.
* Canal Plus falls, pulls Havas lower.
